notes: «شهدا أبا بردة يحدث» makes Abu Burda the narrator whose words are relayed, so he is a link; his father is a bare relation (the Prophet is the end).
عمر بن عبد العزيز is the listener and the one who makes Abu Burda swear, in the scene only: not a link (rule 6).
«فلم يحدثني سعيد أنه استحلفه ولم ينكر على عون قوله» is a remark about the oath, not a second route: left out.
